description: A WorkSpec resource artifact: a single infrastructure node in a topology.

slug.description: Stable filename slug. Optional: the loader derives it from the artifact's filename under `.workspec/<kind-dir>/<slug>.yaml` when absent; when present it must already be a valid slug.

cost.description: This resource's cost binding, if it is priced.

attribution.description: Optional cost split across the c4 containers this resource realizes.

items.description: Attributes a share of a resource's cost to a c4 container.

container.description: The c4 container slug this share is attributed to.

share.description: Fraction of the resource cost attributed to this container.

qty.description: Unit count. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

sku.description: Ref to a decision catalog `skus[].id` this resource prices as.

environments.description: Subset of the owning Topology environments this resource is present in. Omitted means present in ALL of the topology environments — omission is meaningful and must not be defaulted to an explicit list.

items.description: A WorkSpec slug: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens, at most 64 characters (the shape `slugify()` produces).

links.description: Cross-references to other artifacts or docs: exactly one {<linkType>: <pathRef>} pair per entry, plus an optional cardinality key ({from, to, label?}). Path refs must start with "~/" or "@workspace/".

propertyNames.description: The link type, e.g. "adr", "runbook" — or "cardinality" for the optional cardinality key.

network.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → resources/*: the vnet/subnet resource that places this resource in the network-lens view.

additionalProperties.description: A per-environment override patch for one resource: shallow-merged `config`, field-merged `cost`, and full-replace `resourceGroup`/`network`. See the field-level docs for exact per-field merge semantics — `@workspec/topology-model`'s `resolve()` is the only code that applies this patch. MERGE EDGES worth knowing: (1) `config`, being an open bag, CAN be nulled-out per key (the key stays, with a `null` value) but never REMOVED per key — there is no override syntax for "this environment does not have this config key at all". (2) `resourceGroup`/`network` are `Slug`-typed, never nullable, so an override can only REPLACE a placement with a different one — there is no way to override a resource OUT of its resourceGroup/network for one specific environment while the base resource has one; the base ref, if present, always applies unless a DIFFERENT ref replaces it.

config.description: A SHALLOW, top-level patch over the resource's own `spec.config` bag for this environment: a key named here replaces the base value at that key wholesale (including when both are objects — this is NOT a deep/recursive merge); a key not named here inherits the base resource's value unchanged. Setting a key's value to `null` SETS the merged result to `null` — it does not remove the key, since a merge patch has no way to distinguish "not mentioned" from "explicitly cleared".

cost.description: A field-by-field patch over the resource's own `spec.cost` for this environment (sku/mode/schedule/qty/attribution) — see `ResourceCostOverride`.

items.description: Attributes a share of a resource's cost to a c4 container.

container.description: The c4 container slug this share is attributed to.

share.description: Fraction of the resource cost attributed to this container.

mode.description: Override the bound catalog pricing mode id.

schedule.description: Override the bound catalog schedule id.

sku.description: Override the bound catalog SKU id.

network.description: Replaces the resource's own `spec.network` ref for this environment (e.g. a shared dev/test subnet vs. an isolated prod one).

resourceGroup.description: Replaces the resource's own `spec.resourceGroup` ref for this environment (e.g. a pooled dev/test resource group vs. an isolated prod one).

overrides.description: Per-environment override patches (S1), keyed by environment id. `@workspec/topology-model`'s `resolve()` merges the entry for the target environment onto this resource's own `config`/`cost`/`resourceGroup`/`network` — see `ResourceOverride` for the exact per-field merge rule. Two integrity rules apply to every key, BOTH enforced by `@workspec/topology-model` at verify-time, not here: it must be one of the owning Topology's declared `spec.environments` (a standalone Resource file has no visibility into which environments exist, so this can never be schema-level); and this resource must actually be PRESENT in it, per this same file's own (explicit) `spec.environments` — which WOULD be self-contained enough to check here, but deliberately is not (see `ResourceArtifact`'s doc comment for why).

propertyNames.description: A WorkSpec slug: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens, at most 64 characters (the shape `slugify()` produces).

realizes.description: c4 container slugs this resource physically realizes.

resourceGroup.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → resources/*: the resource-group resource that places this resource in the resource-group-lens view.

source.description: Provenance: authored by hand or derived by a tool.

kind.description: Whether a human authored this resource or a tool derived it. Defaults to authored.

type.description: Vendor-specific display type, e.g. "Azure App Service".

title: WorkSpec Resource (v1alpha1)
